/bin/bash -lc ".venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import csv,json,collections
r=list(csv.DictReader(open('unemployment.csv')))
t=json.load(open('counties-10m.json'));gs=t['objects']['counties']['geometries'];ids={str(g['id']).zfill(5) for g in gs};data={x['fips'] for x in r}
print('unique',len(data),'duplicates',len(r)-len(data),'matched',len(data&ids),'unmatched',sorted(data-ids))
print('missing geometry data',[(g['id'],g['properties']) for g in gs if str(g['id']).zfill(5) not in data]);print('states',collections.Counter(x['fips'][:2] for x in r));print('geometry sample',gs[0])
PY"
